svg.title: Known since 2023, still true today
svg.desc: A timeline from 2023 to 2026: 2023 'used unevenly' (2023 models), 2025 '18 models degrade', and the highlighted 2026 point '1M windows rot' (preprints). Each point names its study: Liu et al. (TACL 2023); Chroma Context Rot and NoLiMa (2025); ATLAS and Martin & Roger (2026 preprints).
